customers.evidence: We strive to provide access to safe, effective and affordable medicines and related health care services to the people who need them.

employees.evidence: we are committed to creating an environment where our colleagues can achieve success while contributing to the improved health of the world

dei.evidence: nurturing a workplace of diversity and inclusion for our colleagues

community.evidence: giving back to the communities where we work and live

shareholders.evidence: continue to deliver on our commitments to the patients, customers and shareholders who rely on us

integrity.evidence: we are committed to upholding the highest ethical standards in everything from research and development to sales and marketing

safety.evidence: We strive to set the standard for quality, safety and value in the discovery, development and manufacture of health care products.

innovation.evidence: we are dedicated to making continual progress in innovation by investing our resources wisely

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural voice ('we are committed', 'we strive') with absolute commitment wording. Leads with patients and health access, then customers, colleagues and communities. Shareholders appear only in a single passing clause. Career section frames employees around shared purpose rather than specific workforce terms. Safety and environment are minimal or absent.
